lines.text: Sam drove into the Smokies for the fall colors. No entrance gate, no fee.
He pulled into a trailhead lot, then noticed every other car had a tag on the dashboard.
In this park, any car parked for more than fifteen minutes needs a parking tag.
Here's the fix. Buy a daily, weekly or annual tag before you go,
because most trailheads have no tag machine.
Next morning, Sam's tag sat on the dash.
Save this before your Smokies trip.
